description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuing Certificate of Exemption to Rajawella Holdings Limited for a period from 21.03.2016 to 21.03.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing a Certificate of Exemption under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). The content specifically deals with regulatory matters and compliance requirements, exempting an entity from licensing requirements under existing legislation. This falls squarely within the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it concerns regulatory frameworks and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
